# Pinned reference API families

<!-- Generated by tools/reference_inventory.py --write. -->

This comparison groups related reference members under existing Python handles and formatting properties. It is not an exhaustive member inventory, implementation test, or format-conformance claim. Open XML schema/model APIs do not establish pagination or rendering. Reference products are not runtime dependencies.

Audited local surface: `50220d770c2a6aefb64c41ce15cfc6df039dcf6b`. The inventory contains 44 families and 198 representative members from 17 pinned source files. Later implementation changes require review.

- [dotnet/Open-XML-SDK v3.5.1](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/tree/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42) — `3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42`
- [pymupdf/PyMuPDF 2.0](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/tree/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22) — `b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22`

Local dispositions describe a bounded existing subset, candidate work, recipe or remaining assessment. A family marked upstream-blocked names the specific limitation in its remaining scope; it does not imply the native library lacks all related primitives. See the separate [operation evidence matrix](support-matrix.md) for tested scopes and artifacts.

PyMuPDF core and its separate Office product already document Markdown/structured extraction and Office image rendering respectively. These are reference capabilities, not uniqueness claims for this package.

Maintain `reference-api-inventory.json`; run `python tools/reference_inventory.py` to check or add `--write` to regenerate. The optional `--source-root` checks previously downloaded source hashes and cited member lines. Offline structural checks do not independently retrieve or certify external sources.

## REF-OX-PACKAGE

Package lifecycle and templates.

**Reference members:** [Create](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/blob/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42/src/DocumentFormat.OpenXml/Packaging/WordprocessingDocument.cs#L88), [Open](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/blob/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42/src/DocumentFormat.OpenXml/Packaging/WordprocessingDocument.cs#L239), [CreateFromTemplate](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/blob/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42/src/DocumentFormat.OpenXml/Packaging/WordprocessingDocument.cs#L181), [ChangeDocumentType](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/blob/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42/src/DocumentFormat.OpenXml/Packaging/WordprocessingDocument.cs#L319)

**Criteria / owners:** API2 (W01), API3 (W01), API5 (W03), API6 (W03), DOC1 (W03), DOC2 (W03), DOC3 (W03), DOC4 (W03), DOC6 (W04), DOC8 (W03), C1 (W01), C2 (W13), C5 (W13), PKG1 (W03), PKG3 (W03)

## REF-OX-TEXT

Ordered body/rich text and editing.

**Reference members:** [Body](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/blob/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42/data/schemas/schemas_openxmlformats_org_wordprocessingml_2006_main.json#L45920), [Paragraph](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/blob/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42/data/schemas/schemas_openxmlformats_org_wordprocessingml_2006_main.json#L13538), [Run](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/blob/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42/data/schemas/schemas_openxmlformats_org_wordprocessingml_2006_main.json#L9219), [Text](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/blob/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42/data/schemas/schemas_openxmlformats_org_wordprocessingml_2006_main.json#L3869), [Break](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/blob/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42/data/schemas/schemas_openxmlformats_org_wordprocessingml_2006_main.json#L3848), [TabChar](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/blob/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42/data/schemas/schemas_openxmlformats_org_wordprocessingml_2006_main.json#L4037)

**Audited local surface:** Paragraph.text/add_run/find/replace_text/slices; native explicit breaks; bounded owned DOCX paragraph deletion and same-container movement; PPTX same-cell paragraph deletion/movement reuse the collection.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Append+move composes bounded paragraph insertion; arbitrary block-gap insertion and cross-container adoption remain unavailable. Cross-document Fragment does not remap the complete resource/semantic graph. DOCX movement retains stable paragraph identities, while PPTX movement invalidates ordinal handles in the changed cell. Decimal/bar tabs remain rejected.

**Upstream candidates:** [U02](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-OX-NAVIGATION

Hyperlinks, bookmarks and cross-references.

**Reference members:** [Hyperlink](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/blob/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42/data/schemas/schemas_openxmlformats_org_wordprocessingml_2006_main.json#L18420), [BookmarkStart](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/blob/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42/data/schemas/schemas_openxmlformats_org_wordprocessingml_2006_main.json#L283), [BookmarkEnd](https://github.com/dotnet/Open-XML-SDK/blob/3139fdfd27414548a41555f7848d5728f6e71a42/data/schemas/schemas_openxmlformats_org_wordprocessingml_2006_main.json#L369)

**Criteria / owners:** REF1 (W07), REF2 (W07), REF8 (W07), E4 (W09)

**Audited local surface:** TextRange.link supports external URLs and internal links; whole-paragraph/endpoint body bookmark mapping reuses existing ranges, with checked horizontal nested-cell targets and tested PDF destinations.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Interior/cross-paragraph/imported targets, non-body bookmark targets and general cross-reference evaluation remain unsupported or unassessed.

**Upstream candidates:** [U02](upstream-roadmap.md), [U07](upstream-roadmap.md)

**Evidence profiles:** [word.bookmark-navigation](support-matrix.md#wordbookmark-navigation)

## REF-OX-IMAGE-PLACEMENT

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** DOCX rotation has native ink loss. Front layering has a reproduced native paint-order defect and is rejected. **Reference members:** [insert_pdf](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L91), [insert_file](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L92), [select](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L126), [copy_page](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L57), [move_page](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L107), [delete_pages](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L60)

**Criteria / owners:** P3 (W10), PDF1 (W10), PDF5 (W10), DOC6 (W04)

**Audited local surface:** PdfPages add/insert/move/delete and PdfDocument.copy(pages=...).

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Basic assembly is complete; unsupported document/form structures retain explicit guards. Generic DOCX composition is a different problem.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

**Evidence profiles:** [pdf.page-assembly](support-matrix.md#pdfpage-assembly)

## REF-PM-TEXT

Positioned text and font authoring.

**Reference members:** [insert_text](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L102), [insert_textbox](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L104), [insert_htmlbox](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L103), [insert_font](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L99)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF2 (W10), TXT2 (W04), STY5 (W04)

**Audited local surface:** PdfPage.draw_text point/box; native supplied-font profile; no alternate text engine.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Native supplied-font wrapping/strict clipping and selected font reuse limits require upstream primitives or explicit bounded rejection.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-PM-FLOW

Flowed HTML/story reports and tables.

**Reference members:** [place](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/story-class.rst#L17), [draw](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/story-class.rst#L18), [write](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/story-class.rst#L21), [fit](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/story-class.rst#L25)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF4 (W13), C4 (W13), TBL11 (W13), FORM6 (W13), API10 (W01)

**Audited local surface:** DOCX paragraph/table report recipe then native PDF conversion.

**Disposition:** `recipe_existing`. **Remaining:** Keep this a recipe using existing native layout. Do not introduce HTML/CSS or second report builder to imitate Story object hierarchy.

**Upstream candidates:** None identified in this family audit.

## REF-PM-IMAGE

Image insertion, replacement and removal.

**Reference members:** [insert_image](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L100), [replace_image](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L112), [delete_image](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L69), [get_images](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L89)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF2 (W10), MED1 (W06), MED3 (W06), BG4 (W13)

**Audited local surface:** Existing owned Office picture operations and PDF PNG/JPEG add_image use native media APIs; PDF behind=True reuses the existing crop/quarter-turn/flip controls.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Source PDF image replacement/removal and broader alpha/blend profiles require separate native acceptance. DOCX/PPTX authored picture formats remain limited to their existing PNG profiles; PDF accepts PNG/JPEG.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-PM-VECTOR

Vector paths, fills and paint ordering.

**Reference members:** [draw_line](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/shape.rst#L27), [draw_rect](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/shape.rst#L31), [draw_bezier](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/shape.rst#L24), [finish](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/shape.rst#L12), [commit](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/shape.rst#L12)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF3 (W10), MED4 (W06), BG7 (W06)

**Audited local surface:** PdfPage.draw_path; built-in PdfPage.draw_text and PNG/JPEG add_image reuse behind=True for typed native underlays; typed PPTX shape properties.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Raw draw_path and supplied-font text remain overlay-only. Resource-collision-safe composition and bounded raw-stream admission remain open; existing resource collisions fail atomically. No adapter-built Form/layer system is introduced.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-PM-FORM-COMPOSITION

Source PDF page-as-form/background composition.

**Reference members:** [show_pdf_page](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L120)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF3 (W10), BG2 (W13), BG4 (W13), DOC6 (W04)

**Audited local surface:** No facade for arbitrary source-page Form composition.

**Disposition:** `upstream_or_unassessed`. **Remaining:** Native Form traversal silently caps4096visits/depth12; bounded aggregate decoding/UserUnit correctness and public overlay control needed.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-PM-RASTER

DPI rasterization, clipping and alpha behavior.

**Reference members:** [get_pixmap](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L92)

**Criteria / owners:** R1 (W02), R2 (W02), R3 (W02), R4 (W02), P1 (W02), P2 (W02), API9 (W13), QA4 (W14), QA7 (W14)

**Audited local surface:** render_page/get_pixmap return encoded PNG; region clip and private retained native sessions; selected DeckCraft PNG/PDF paths use fallible per-call APIs; PDF checks final rounded integer allocation dimensions.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Explicit output alpha/backdrop replacement remains unproven. Broader upstream allocation/work limits, structured errors and other rendering entry points remain open. A real blank slide is still valid; no Pixmap wrapper is introduced.

**Upstream candidates:** [U09](upstream-roadmap.md)

**Evidence profiles:** [pdf.region](support-matrix.md#pdfregion)

## REF-PM-EXTRACTION

Text geometry, links, tables and source grounding.

**Reference members:** [get_text](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L94), [get_links](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L91), [find_tables](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L83), [search_for](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L113)

**Criteria / owners:** E1 (W09), E2 (W09), E4 (W09), P4 (W02), LAY8 (W06), REF8 (W07)

**Audited local surface:** Owned normalized blocks/cells/links and source metadata; eager open, selected extract_text and retained native PDF Page.search_for with bounded ordered rectangles.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Native PDF table detector remains private. Exact Office line slices and broader provenance are open; search is not OCR, regex, visible-only matching or normalized-offset reconstruction.

**Upstream candidates:** [U05](upstream-roadmap.md), [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

**Evidence profiles:** [pdf.native-search](support-matrix.md#pdfnative-search)

## REF-PM-MARKDOWN

Markdown, chunking and structured extraction.

**Reference members:** [to_markdown](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L143), [to_chunks](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L141), [to_json](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L142), [to_text](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L144)

**Criteria / owners:** E2 (W09), E5 (W03), E6 (W09), P4 (W02)

**Audited local surface:** to_markdown/export_markdown and normalized owned values; no RAG chunk framework.

**Disposition:** `reference_comparison`. **Remaining:** PyMuPDF2.0 already documents these APIs; packaging/licensing/Office semantic coverage can differ, not generic novelty. Chunk metadata is reference-only.

**Upstream candidates:** None identified in this family audit.

## REF-PM-NAVIGATION

Links, outlines, metadata and page labels.

**Reference members:** [get_toc](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L86), [set_toc](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L137), [set_metadata](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L130), [set_page_labels](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L133)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF5 (W10), DOC7 (W03), REF1 (W07), REF2 (W07), REF8 (W07)

**Audited local surface:** Owned bookmarks/links/metadata and preserved imported labels; no combined reference engine.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Current named-destination/outline depth limits and unsupported document properties need explicit profiles; broader page label authoring is separate acceptance.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

## REF-PM-ANNOTATIONS

Annotation operations and appearances.

**Reference members:** [update](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/annot.rst#L41), [set_colors](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/annot.rst#L30), [set_opacity](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/annot.rst#L35), [set_border](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/annot.rst#L28), [set_flags](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/annot.rst#L301)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF6 (W10), REV1 (W07), REV6 (W13)

**Audited local surface:** Existing note/markup/link and bounded rectangle/ellipse annotation handles and typed properties; strict boolean lock for seven canonical comment kinds.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Fixed-profile geometric comments do not establish opacity/fill/reply or arbitrary appearance support. Caller-bounded native inventories remain upstream work; PDF annotations are distinct from tracked DOCX review. Local locked exposes only the native editing-lock bit, excludes links, and is not arbitrary flag editing or access control.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

**Evidence profiles:** [pdf.geometric-comments](support-matrix.md#pdfgeometric-comments), [pdf.comment-locks](support-matrix.md#pdfcomment-locks)

## REF-PM-FORMS

Interactive widgets and field values.

**Reference members:** [field_name](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L92), [field_value](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L104), [field_type](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L114), [rect](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L134), [choice_values](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L88), [update](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L58), [field_label](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L100), [field_flags](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/widget.rst#L110)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF6 (W10), FORM3 (W08), PKG5 (W03)

**Audited local surface:** PdfFields/PdfField owned text/checkbox/choice profile with geometry/value updates and bounded Unicode tooltip metadata and strict read_only state.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** Imported enumeration silently truncates/loses widgets/unknown kinds; require public fallible bounded inventory before safe general source-form editing. Script/signature behavior is excluded. The local tooltip is an empty string when absent; this is not a promise to match the reference field-label fallback or imported metadata behavior. Local read_only exposes only READ_ONLY and native filling refusal, including identical/clear assignments; it is not arbitrary flags, widget synchronization or security parity.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

**Evidence profiles:** [pdf.owned-fields](support-matrix.md#pdfowned-fields)

## REF-PM-REDACTION

Redaction markers versus irreversible content removal.

**Reference members:** [add_redact_annot](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L54), [apply_redactions](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/page.rst#L64)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF7 (W10), REV6 (W13)

**Audited local surface:** No secure redaction runtime API promised.

**Disposition:** `upstream_blocked`. **Remaining:** Native vertical writing unsupported; vector/shading residual semantics and aggregate bounds insufficient. Overlay rectangles never substitute for removal.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

**Evidence profiles:** [pdf.vertical-redaction](support-matrix.md#pdfvertical-redaction)

## REF-PM-OUTPUT-PROFILES

Cleanup, encryption, incremental save and embedded files.

**Reference members:** [scrub](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L124), [saveIncr](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L123), [can_save_incrementally](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L53), [embfile_add](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L61), [embfile_get](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/document.rst#L64)

**Criteria / owners:** PDF8 (W10), PKG1 (W03), PKG2 (W03), PKG5 (W03), PKG6 (W03), PKG7 (W03), PKG8 (W03), REV6 (W13)

**Audited local surface:** PDF save/to_bytes select object streams or classic cross-reference full output; neither is a new conversion pair or archival profile.

**Disposition:** `implemented_subset`. **Remaining:** General cleanup/compression and incremental/encrypted output remain unassessed. Page FileAttachment creation is public; document EmbeddedFiles mutation remains private. Native strict caller-limited full-chain decoding exists; bounded complete attachment inventory, unambiguous identity and integrated bounded extraction remain upstream work. Arbitrary encryption/active-content/PDF-A/UA profiles are unassessed. No raw PDF object escape hatch.

**Upstream candidates:** [U10](upstream-roadmap.md)

**Evidence profiles:** [pdf.object-stream-output](support-matrix.md#pdfobject-stream-output)

## REF-PM-OFFICE

Separate Office product reference.

**Reference members:** [get_pixmap](https://github.com/pymupdf/PyMuPDF/blob/b8904b27efa0c4e2258f0e46ab4498a6173ffa22/docs/pymupdf-office/index.rst#L170)

**Criteria / owners:** R1 (W02), R2 (W02), C2 (W13), E1 (W09), E3 (W09), SLIDE1 (W11)

**Audited local surface:** Existing Office render/extract uses permissive pinned native crates without runtime license service.

**Disposition:** `reference_comparison`. **Remaining:** Office reference is separate commercial product; it already renders Office pages. This does not establish an editable DOCX authoring API or market uniqueness.

**Upstream candidates:** None identified in this family audit.
